visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Sliced green zucchini rounds are neatly arranged on a silver wire rack lined with white parchment paper inside a dark baking tray. (2) Two large, raw chicken thighs with skin on, marinated in a light sauce, are placed directly on top of the zucchini slices. (3) A close-up shot of a black and silver electronic steam oven interface shows a hand with a white smartphone reflection pressing buttons on the control panel which displays digital text and time. (4) The oven door is pulled open by a hand wearing a white quilted oven mitt, revealing the golden-brown, sizzling chicken and cooked zucchini inside. (5) Close-up on a white oval plate where a hand uses silver kitchen scissors to cut a piece of the roasted chicken; clear juices are seen leaking from the meat as it is sliced. (6) A hand sprinkles freshly chopped green onions over the sliced chicken pieces and zucchini on the plate. (7) A person's hand holds the finished plate of yogurt-marinated chicken thighs and zucchini up toward the camera in a bright kitchen environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A light, upbeat acoustic guitar melody with a steady percussive beat starts, creating a warm and cheerful atmosphere. (2) Music continues as several distinct high-pitched electronic 'beeps' and a series of tactile mechanical 'clicks' are heard from the appliance buttons. (3) A brief metallic 'clink' and a sliding friction sound occur as the heavy oven door is opened, followed by faint sizzling textures. (4) Multiple sharp, percussive 'snip' sounds of metal scissors cutting through a crispy, fleshy texture are heard in quick succession over the music. (5) The cheerful acoustic guitar and percussion loop continues at a consistent volume until the track abruptly ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a short instructional recipe demo for making yogurt-marinated chicken thighs using a Sharp Healsio steam oven, emphasizing the juiciness of the result and providing a call-to-action in the comments.
